title: A Synthetic Benchmark for Target-Centric Causal Discovery in Industrial Processes
abstract: arXiv:2611.17556v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Causal discovery promises to find which recorded variables drive a process target such as product quality, yield or energy use. Process data with known causes are rare, and in existing benchmarks the difficulty of identifying the causes of a target is either fixed by the recorded data or set for the whole graph. We present a synthetic benchmark for target-centric causal discovery in industrial processes. Its generator is a two-level structural causal model inspired by batch production, assembled from components that each model one phenomenon of process data, such as a control loop or a delayed effect. The graph is built around the target: without sensor error, every non-cause can be distinguished from the direct causes by conditioning on them or by time order. translated_title: 一种面向工业过程目标中心因果发现的合成基准
translated_abstract: 因果发现有望找出哪些记录变量驱动过程目标，例如产品质量、产量或能耗。具有已知原因的过程数据十分罕见，而在现有基准中，识别目标原因的难度要么由记录的数据所固定，要么针对整个图统一设置。我们提出了一个用于工业过程目标中心因果发现的合成基准。其生成器是一个受批量生产启发的两层结构因果模型，由各自模拟过程数据某一现象（如控制回路或延迟效应）的组件组装而成。该图围绕目标构建：在没有传感器误差的情况下，每个非原因都可以通过对其条件化或依据时间顺序与直接原因区分开来。每个组件均可独立设置，因此可以一次改变一个条件来调整难度。我们评估了八种方法，从关联度量到效应估计（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出了一个用于工业过程目标中心因果发现的合成基准，其生成器是受批量生产启发的两层结构因果模型，由可独立设置的组件构成，能够逐一调节识别目标原因的难度，从而系统评估各类因果发现方法。
en_tdlr: The paper presents a synthetic benchmark for target-centric causal discovery in industrial processes, built on a two-level structural causal model generator with independently configurable components that allow the difficulty of identifying a target's causes to be varied one condition at a time.
